record.title: Complete the observed command pair and capture the next stock access
record.intent: Follow stock initialization beyond the now-observed two-write prefix.
requirements: Use the controlled executable and unchanged stock artifacts in a fresh pinned guest.
Permit only the two existing reads and two observed stores at ELF0x27043c opcode0xb9000109 offset0x3000 in the exact observed order.
Run normally after each PC-only store completion and stop at the next unsupported access from any covered thread.
Capture thread events, terminal state, preservation and cleanup or a precise negative outcome.
acceptance: Record the next access without supplying another response and separate it from static initialization predictions.
No physical instrument, ADC-ready, timing-fidelity or acquisition claim.
